channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with history and global artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is reshaping Fort Pierce's cultural landscape by establishing the Peacock Arts District as a hub for artistic expression. Located within the historic Crain Estate, this nonprofit organization honors the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain, the property's original owners.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to South Florida roads
item.description: A record 72.2 million Americans will have traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5, with 61.4 million making the trip by car. South Florida drivers are feeling the impact with heavy rain adding to crowded roads.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach is celebrating after being named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. The city was the only Florida community selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents seek fence restoration at JB-7 beach access as town considers $6,000 fix
item.description: A missing fence at the JB-7 public beach access point in Juno Beach is creating tension between Colony Condos residents and summer beachgoers. The town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons, and now residents say people are cutting through their private property.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams on standby as Fourth of July boaters take to the water
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is preparing for hundreds of boaters on the water this Fourth of July weekend with two boats equipped with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiancee Misty Dawn White in deadly home fire
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is receiving community support after losing his fiancee, Misty Dawn White, 46, in a deadly home fire Monday. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, a 48-year-old breast cancer patient, and her surgeon are speaking out after her insurance company denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for new fence at JB-7 beach access as trespassing complaints rise
item.description: A missing fence at a Juno Beach public beach access point is creating tension between condo residents and summer beachgoers, and a fix could cost the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as inflation hits holiday meals
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves ahead with Midway Road widening and new Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange at the Florida Turnpike.

item.title: Autonomous transit company proposes elevated system connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Fort Pierce Peacock House Art Foundation connects local and international artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while hosting an artist-in-residency program that attracts creators from around the world.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation that will nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to last one year.

item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge arguing a judge erred in recommending reinstatement of Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy since 2009.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes July 6 for $3 million renovation to nearly double boat slip capacity
item.description: The downtown public dock will close for a year-long renovation that will expand from 18 to 44 slips for motorized and non-motorized vessels.

item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire destroyed the couple's home in Hobe Sound. Preliminary findings point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.
